name: Monster Hunter Wilds

ps5.save_hint: Export the decrypted save with an on-console save manager; the folder holds data001Slot.bin (and data00-1.bin).

options.label: SteamID64 of the Steam account that will play this save
options.help: The 17-digit id (starts with 7656) of the PC account that will load the converted save. Find it on your Steam profile or steamdb.info/calculator.

options.label: SteamID64 of the Steam account that made this save
options.help: Leave blank to detect it from the save automatically. Only needed if detection fails.

notes: Only the character save (data001Slot.bin) carries your hunters; system settings stay per-platform and in-game photos don't transfer.

Converting to another platform means a new account, so the online hunter identity is reset and the game issues a fresh one when you next go online — friends, followers and squads from the old account won't carry over.
Keep a backup of the save you're replacing.

ps5_to_pc: Close the game and Steam, and back up your current win64_save folder.
Copy the converted file(s) into win64_save, replacing what's there.
If Steam Cloud reports a conflict on launch, keep the local files.
Go online once so the game issues a new hunter id.
pc_to_ps5: Import the converted file(s) with an on-console save manager, re-encrypting for your console.
Go online once so the game issues a new hunter id.
